caption: The drawing depicts six rectangular medallions with scenes in low relief, arranged in two rows of three. All the medallions are rendered in shades of gray and beige on a light, off-white background. The first medallion in the top row shows a person sitting on a bench holding a long staff or tool, wearing a broad-brimmed hat, with a background of leaves and a building. The second medallion features two figures shaking hands, both standing, and dressed in colonial-style clothing, positioned against a plain background. The third medallion displays one figure kneeling and another standing above, reaching out as though in assistance, with trees and plants visible in the background. In the bottom row, the first medallion illustrates a standing figure gripping the wheel of a cannon or large wheeled device, wearing similar colonial attire. The second presents two individuals interacting beside a flag and a large leafy plant, with one holding the flagpole. The final medallion depicts a scene with two figures throwing boxes from a ship into the water, amid stylized waves. Below the medallions, the title “MEDALLIONS FORMING BAND AROUND BOTTOM OF VASE” is inscribed in pencil, and the name “JOHN DANA” appears in the lower right corner. All elements are created with light and dark shading to convey depth and dimension.
title: Vase
